title: Sources: Alibaba's Amap will soon launch an AI tool to let restaurants render 3D images by just uploading videos or photos, in a bid to compete with Meituan (Debby Wu/Bloomberg)
summary: Debby Wu / Bloomberg: Sources: Alibaba's Amap will soon launch an AI tool to let restaurants render 3D images by just uploading videos or photos, in a bid to compete with Meituan — Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. is launching a service to help restaurants use AI to showcase interiors, part of a broader effort …
